message: formalcode: pc-eye link is green (coord_space consistent, move exact). Starting the chess engine build.

Chess engine done, 2 commits pushed.

HONEST HEADLINE: drawing Stockfish 17.1 at max from the start position is impossible - it is ~3600 Elo. I did not fake a win. What IS proved:

- 8/8 theoretically drawn positions HELD vs Stockfish 17.1 full strength (ground truth = lichess tablebase, not Stockfish's opinion). Includes a 137-ply Philidor R+P vs R defence.
- Beats SF Skill 0 (6-0) and Skill 2 (9/1/2). Loses to Skill 5+ - reported as losses.
- Absolute strength ~1850 Elo at 100ms/move (±100), from two SF UCI_Elo brackets that agree.

TESTS: 26/26 perft (incl. kiwipete d4), 21/21 UCI conformance with python-chess as independent ground truth, 0 illegal moves in 72 games.

Bugs found and fixed by tests: promotion table typo made queens report as rooks; no draw detection in search. Also caught 3 of my own bogus 'known draws' - one was mate for the wrong side - and an impossible FEN that segfaulted Stockfish.

LICHESS: offline analysis board only. No online games. Confirmed by playing the engine's own move c2c4 on lichess/analysis and reading the FEN back: rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/2P5/8/PP1PPPPP/RNBQKBNR b KQkq - 0 1
